wiki.title: Matthew Longjohn
wiki.extract: Matthew M. Longjohn is an American physician and politician serving as a member of the Michigan House of Representatives since January 2025, representing the 40th district. A member of the Democratic Party, he was the Democratic nominee for Michigan's 6th congressional district in the 2018 elections, losing to incumbent Fred Upton.
